meta.name: MoneyPrinterTurbo AI Video Materials
meta.description: Batch-generate subtitle-free, voiceover-free short-video footage clips for MoneyPrinterTurbo.
meta.inputSummary: Scene description, aspect ratio, and scene index

steps.instruction: Generate a standalone video footage clip usable in short-video editing. Do not generate subtitles, text, titles, watermarks, logos, or voiceover audio. Keep subject motion and camera movement natural, and avoid abrupt cuts.

instructions: Generate one standalone MP4 footage clip per row.
The scene index keeps multiple clips of the same topic visually distinct.

fields.label: Scene description
fields.description: The picture, subject, action, and camera requirements for the clip to generate

presentation.placeholder: e.g. A worker in a modern office using an AI assistant, natural light, slow push-in shot

fields.label: Aspect ratio
fields.description: The aspect ratio used by the final MoneyPrinterTurbo cut

fields.label: Scene index
fields.description: The 1-based scene number within the same batch

values.scenePrompt: A worker in a modern office using an AI assistant, natural light, slow push-in shot, no text, no watermark
